jobs.company: Senior Helpers of Baltimore and Central Maryland
jobs.title: Client Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
Client Care Coordinator

Senior Helpers of Baltimore and Central Maryland

Lutherville-Timonium, Maryland | Full-time | On-site with local travel
$50,000–$62,000 annually, based on experience, plus quarterly performance bonuses and benefits

Great home care starts long before a caregiver walks through the front door. It starts with listening, understanding what matters most, and helping a family feel confident about the next step.

We’re hiring a Client Care Coordinator who brings empathy, initiative, and strong relationship-building together into one meaningful role.

You’ll guide families from their first inquiry and assessment through enrollment and a successful start of care. Then you’ll own those relationships—staying connected, addressing concerns, and helping services evolve as needs change.

This role combines compassionate client service, consultative sales, and care coordination. Your ability to build trust and follow through will directly shape the client experience and our agency’s growth.

WHY JOIN US?
💜 The first and only home care agency in Maryland to earn CHAP Age-Friendly Care at Home Certification
💜 A team committed to raising the standard in home care
💜 A culture that believes great care starts with great people
💜 Meaningful ownership of client relationships, supported by experienced operations and nursing leadership

Our approach brings together the Age-Friendly 4Ms framework—What Matters, Medication, Mentation, and Mobility—with LIFE Profile assessments, Senior Gems dementia care, and hands-on caregiver training in our Center of Excellence.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Help families choose and begin care:
• Respond promptly to qualified inquiries and maintain consistent follow-up.
• Conduct non-clinical assessments, including Senior Helpers LIFE Profile assessments, in homes, facilities, and other approved settings.
• Understand client routines, preferences, support needs, family expectations, and urgency.
• Recommend appropriate services, schedules, and care hours.
• Explain service options, pricing, and agreements; address questions; and guide families toward informed enrollment decisions.
• Coordinate onboarding, caregiver introductions, and timely service starts.
Build relationships that last:
• Serve as the primary non-clinical relationship owner for an assigned portfolio of clients and families.
• Lead proactive calls, client visits, first-day and first-month follow-up, and satisfaction outreach.
• Complete assigned non-clinical reassessments and service-plan updates.
• Recognize concerns early, coordinate solutions, and follow through to resolution.
• Recommend service adjustments or additional support when changing needs and family goals warrant them.
• Reconnect with prospective and former clients when services may meet their needs.
Keep care coordinated:
• Partner with nursing, scheduling, caregivers, and business development to support responsive, consistent service.
• Coordinate service agreements, authorizations, payer-program documentation, and care transitions.
• Escalate clinical concerns, safety risks, and serious complaints to appropriate leadership.
• Maintain accurate client, assessment, service-plan, and pipeline records in WellSky.
• Support billing accuracy, quality assurance, and documentation compliance.
• Review conversion, satisfaction, retention, and service-utilization trends to recommend improvements.

WHAT YOU BRING

• One to three years of relevant experience preferred in home care, healthcare, senior services, admissions, care coordination, consultative sales, client services, or account management.
• Confidence assessing needs, explaining solutions, discussing pricing, and helping people make decisions.
• Strong communication, organization, problem-solving, and follow-through.
• The ability to balance empathy with accountability for client experience and business results.
• Sound judgment and comfort managing competing priorities.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office and comfort learning healthcare or client-management systems; WellSky experience is preferred.
• A valid driver’s license, current automobile insurance, reliable transportation, and availability for local travel.
• A bachelor’s degree in a related field is preferred.
Experience working with older adults and families is strongly preferred. Clinical assessments and decisions remain with appropriately licensed personnel.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Families receive timely, thoughtful guidance. Qualified inquiries become appropriate service starts. Clients feel heard and supported. Concerns are resolved, records stay current, and services evolve responsibly with each client’s needs.
You’ll report to the Director of Operations, with goals and priorities reviewed during your first 30, 60, and 90 days.

COMPENSATION & WORK ENVIRONMENT

• Annual base salary of $50,000–$62,000, based on experience.
• Quarterly performance bonuses.
• Benefits and PTO
• Full-time, based at our office at 1313 York Road in Lutherville-Timonium.
• Regular local travel throughout Baltimore and Central Maryland for assessments and client visits.
• Reasonable schedule flexibility to respond to prospective and active client needs.

If you want your work to matter—and want to help shape the future of aging care in Maryland—we’d love to meet you.
Senior Helpers is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to an inclusive, respectful, and professional workplace.

jobs.title: Associate Patient Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by diversity and inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health equity on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together.

The Associate Patient Care Coordinator (Primary Care/Internal Medicine)
is responsible to the Center Administrator and provides appointment scheduling, patient registration, cashiering, answers incoming calls and performs other related clerical functions. This primary role provides front office support functions.

Schedule:
Monday-Friday, 8-hour shift between the hours of 7:30am-5pm EST. Schedule to be determined by manager upon hire.

Location
: 307 W. Main St. Kent, OH. Training and coverage may be required at Tallmadge location (116 East Ave, Ste 3, Tallmadge, OH 44278), depending on business need.

Primary Responsibilities

Taking messages for providers, handling forms: FMLA/Disability/BMV
Collecting copays and patient balances that are due at time of check in
Requesting records and retrieving records from offices/hospitals
Prepping charts, scanning documents
Verifies patient insurance coverage and eligibility utilizing computer-based patient registration / scheduling system
Documents appropriate information in patient's charts using an electronic medical records system
Completes and maintains physician's schedules, coordinating patient visits and medical procedures
Ensure patient insurance information through EMR system

What Are The Reasons To Consider Working For UnitedHealth Group? Put It All Together - Competitive Base Pay, a Full And Comprehensive Benefit Program, Performance Rewards, And a Management Team Who Demonstrates Their Commitment To Your Success. Some Of Our Offerings Include

Paid Time Off which you start to accrue with your first pay period plus 8 Paid Holidays
Medical Plan options along with participation in a Health Spending Account or a Health Saving account
Dental, Vision, Life& AD&D Insurance along with Short-term disability and Long-Term Disability coverage
401(k) Savings Plan, Employee Stock Purchase Plan
Education Reimbursement
Employee Discounts
Employee Assistance Program
Employee Referral Bonus Program
Voluntary Benefits (pet insurance, legal insurance, LTC Insurance, etc.)

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

Required Qualifications

High School Diploma/GED
1+ years of customer services experience and/or experience working in a healthcare environment
Must be 18 years of age or older

Preferred Qualifications

Experience utilizing electronic medical records
Medical office experience
Advanced level of proficiency with the use of PC, typing capabilities and various software applications such as Microsoft Word and Outlook

Soft Skills

Proven excellent customer service skills and ability to multi-task necessary

Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The hourly pay for this role will range from $16.00 to $29.00 per hour based on full-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable.

At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.

UnitedHealth Group is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer under applicable law and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, religion, age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations.

UnitedHealth Group is a drug-free workplace. Candidates are required to pass a drug test before beginning employment.

jobs.title: After Hours Care Coordinator (Remote | Part-Time)
jobs.description:
The After-Hours Coordinator serves as the main point of contact for clients, caregivers, and staff outside of regular business hours. This role is responsible for responding to urgent calls, coordinating caregiver coverage for call-outs and schedule changes, addressing client concerns, documenting incidents, and helping ensure there are no interruptions in care.

The After-Hours Coordinator works closely with the care team to address issues quickly, maintain quality of service, and provide support to both clients and caregivers during evenings, weekends, and holidays.

After-Hours Schedule

Monday–Friday:
4:30 PM – 8:00 AM the following morning

Weekend Coverage:
Weekend coverage is required every weekend on a rotating schedule. Coordinators alternate between Saturday and Sunday coverage each week.

One weekend: Saturday, 8:00 AM – 8:00 AM Sunday
Following weekend: Sunday, 8:00 AM – 8:00 AM Monday

This rotation allows for consistent after-hours coverage while sharing weekend responsibilities among the team.

Typical After-Hours Calls

Calls are primarily related to urgent staffing and client care needs that occur outside of normal business hours.

Typical calls may include:

Caregiver call-outs due to illness, emergencies, transportation issues, or other unexpected absences
Schedule changes requested by clients, families, or caregivers
Finding replacement caregivers when a scheduled caregiver is unable to work
Client concerns or complaints that require immediate attention
Caregiver questions regarding client care plans, shift details, or emergency procedures
Emergency situations involving client health or safety, including hospitalizations, falls, or situations requiring emergency services
Late arrivals or no-shows reported by clients or caregivers
Hospital admissions or discharges that require updates to the care schedule
Requests for additional services or visits outside of the regular schedule

The majority of after-hours calls are related to caregiver call-outs, finding coverage, schedule adjustments, and client concerns that need an immediate response. This role is essential to helping ensure uninterrupted care and maintaining a positive experience for our clients and caregivers.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who is:

Highly organized and dependable
Comfortable multitasking and managing multiple priorities
Able to stay calm and professional in a fast-paced environment
Strong at problem-solving and communication
Comfortable making decisions and handling urgent situations
Responsive and reliable during scheduled after-hours coverage

Compensation

$18/hour + on-call stipend: $40 per weekday and $50 per weekend day.

We’re looking for someone who is highly organized, dependable, able to multitask effectively, and skilled at prioritizing responsibilities in a fast-paced environment. If that sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you!

ORA_ON_SITE

Description

SAIC has an immediate opening on an exciting mission focused program in Chantilly. We are seeking a driven candidate to support a variety of activities directly related to engagement with internal and external partners. Day-to-day support will revolve around helping the customer with the nuanced details of coordinating and facilitating the successful accomplishment of operational support related to external partner engagement. You will be aligned to an operational element of the customer organization, but will also coordinate with other customer and contractor personnel supporting this broader activity.

Qualifications

Must currently hold a TS/SCI and Poly in order to be considered
Project Management Professional certification (PMP) is required
Minimum of 9 years of relevant experience
Bachelor's Degree or relevant experience can be substituted for the degree
Experience managing technical projects with the ability to drive progress toward deliveries and due dates, manage dependencies between efforts, and communicate with stakeholders
Demonstrated experience in end-to-end planning and documentation, optimization, change, and risk management
Demonstrated experience and deep knowledge of the customer's internal and external communication and deconfliction processes and methods to manage internal and external communications
Apply exceptional interpersonal skills and experience using customer processes to enhance and drive external partner engagement, achieve specific objectives for customer priorities, and translate external perspectives and organizational dynamics to the customer
Ability to work independently to respond in a timely manner to field elements, obtain answers to questions, complete write-ups of meetings with external partners, and ensure that critical parts of meetings are captured in official communications
Ability to ensure plans are communicated to all stakeholders, prompt responses to mission elements and internal management are given, responses that need input from others are tracked, and inputs or responses to questions are proactively completed
While the position doesn't require hands-on technical knowledge, the candidate must have the ability acquire a level of familiarity with the customer's technology, as it is necessary to be conversant on the customer's projects and to have context important to stakeholder engagement
Must have exceptional organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to "get things to done"
Must have the mentality that no job is beneath you. This is a highly dynamic and streamlined team and everyone must pitch in wherever needed, even if that doesn't directly relate to the primary job functions

Target salary range: $160,001 - $200,000. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors.
